ProjectAIRequest.description:
One task-scoped project question bound to an immutable revision.

``analysis_id`` stays for shared-harness compatibility but is unused by
project work and defaults to the empty string.
ProjectAIRequest.title: ProjectAIRequest

ProjectChangeActionRequest.description: Review action body: the caller's expected latest project revision.
ProjectChangeActionRequest.title: ProjectChangeActionRequest

ProjectChangeEditRequest.description: One requested file edit inside a reviewed proposal; content stays inert.
ProjectChangeEditRequest.title: ProjectChangeEditRequest

ProjectChangeProposalRequest.description:
POST body for creating a reviewed proposal.

Per-file/per-set budgets (32 files, 1 MiB total) stay enforced by the change
engine, never by the wire model, so the same limits apply to calls that skip
the HTTP layer.
ProjectChangeProposalRequest.title: ProjectChangeProposalRequest

ProjectContextManifest.description: The typed, sanitized initial-context manifest assembled for one request.
ProjectContextManifest.title: ProjectContextManifest

ProjectContextPreview.description:
Typed, inert preview of the bounded initial context for one request.

It carries only the frozen project/revision identity, the assembled chat
messages, a conservative token bound and the json tool descriptors. Building
it never contacts a model profile, sends inference or persists a task, and
the inventory is bounded to relative names and kinds (no source bodies).
ProjectContextPreview.title: ProjectContextPreview

ProjectEvidenceReceipt.description: An evidence receipt for a sanitized snapshot observation.
ProjectEvidenceReceipt.title: ProjectEvidenceReceipt

ProjectExecutionReceipt.description:
Durable loaded-file receipt attached to a project run finish payload.

``complete`` means the load ledger was finalized and flushed, independent of
whether the user's calculation succeeded; any budget omission makes it false.
ProjectExecutionReceipt.title: ProjectExecutionReceipt

ProjectFileInventoryItem.description: A bounded, source-free inventory entry (relative name + kind only).
ProjectFileInventoryItem.title: ProjectFileInventoryItem

ProjectLoadedFile.description:
One file the interpreter actually entered during a project run.

Paths are root-relative and sanitized; no machine path or source body is
ever carried. ``file_id`` is empty for an in-root file outside the frozen
manifest, which keeps a coverage gap explicit instead of implying membership.
ProjectLoadedFile.title: ProjectLoadedFile

ProjectReadPermission.description: Permission summary: which indexed files, and which line spans, are readable.
ProjectReadPermission.title: ProjectReadPermission

ProjectRecoveryState.description: GET /{pid}/changes/recovery: a public recovery summary, no private data.
ProjectRecoveryState.title: ProjectRecoveryState

ProjectSection.description: Persistent project identity; authored beside (never inside) observations.
ProjectSection.title: ProjectSection

ProjectToolReceipt.description: A versioned tool receipt: the only token a model may cite.
ProjectToolReceipt.title: ProjectToolReceipt

RunConfiguration.description: Authored, inert launch intent reused by P2/P3 (never executed here).
RunConfiguration.title: RunConfiguration

RuntimeReferenceState.description: Fresh, sanitized machine runtime state (never carries private values).
RuntimeReferenceState.title: RuntimeReferenceState
